description: ASSET PRESERVATION PROGRAM - CONSTRUCTION/ UPGRADING/ REHABILITATION OF DRAINAGE ALONG NATIONAL ROADS - SECONDARY ROADS - TAGAYTAY-BATANGAS VIA TUY RD - K0064 + 480 - K0065 + 155
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.

items.label: Very fast award after bid opening
items.detail: Award made 7 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)

items.label: Two bidders
items.detail: 2 bidder(s) recorded. Not linked to failed contracts in past data, so not scored.

items.label: Regional cost factor
items.detail: Prices for similar works in Region IV-A (CALABARZON) run ×1.25 the national median; adjusted for the region: ₱22.3M per km vs national 95th percentile ₱91.6M.

items.label: A bidder had an earlier contract terminated
items.detail: Pgm Construction & Plumbing Services: 1 of 11 earlier road contracts terminated

families.name: Contractor ownership, affiliation and bidding networks

items.label: Winner holds many of this office's contracts
items.detail: High same-office concentration observed (context only, not scored)

items.label: Repeat co-bidders
items.detail: Sdwc Construction and Pgm Construction & Plumbing Services bid in the same 4 earlier tenders (wins 4–0).

items.label: Political dynasties in the province (Ateneo dataset)
items.detail: 41% of Cavite's elected local positions were held by fat-dynastic officials after the 2022 election (23% in 1992); median province 29%; largest clan: Tolentino (1.8% of positions); family poverty incidence 3% (2012).

items.label: Potential dynasts after the 2025 election (House CPBRD inventory)
items.detail: 62% of elected officials in the province have potential dynastic links (national average 54.5%; broader name matching than the Ateneo measure).

items.label: Dynastic district representatives (2022)
items.detail: Aniela Tolentino, Boying Remulla, Roy Loyola, Lani Mercado-Revilla, Ramon Jolo Revilla (Ateneo dataset).

items.label: Political families in the province
items.detail: 0 of 1 elected officials in Cavite (2025-2028) have a relative also in elective office (0%; national median 25%).

assessment.derivation: 0 strong + 2 weak signal(s) → Medium priority (1 strong, or 2 weak) → Yellow.

steps.title: Confirm the basic facts on the official DPWH page
sub: Budget, location, status, dates and bidders match this page.

steps.title: Open the bid documents
sub: Look for the quantities, a Bill of Quantities and technical specifications.

steps.title: Read Claude's check and confirm its points against the sources
Verify the risk: Procurement competition and bidding patterns
sub: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.

steps.title: Verify the risk: Contractor history and performance
sub: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

steps.title: Check site and field evidence
sub: Check the site before work starts: satellite imagery of the stretch, earlier contracts on the same road, and whether a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, a TPM civil-society partner) can take geotagged photos later.

steps.title: Write down what you found and keep the documents you relied on
sub: Screenshots, Bill of Quantities pages, photos or letters: attach them with your decision.
